result.summary: The intersection features a marked continental crosswalk and sidewalks on the commercial corner, but lacks visible pedestrian signals. The wide roadway and car-centric land use create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians crossing the main thoroughfare.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island on the main thoroughfare.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center of the image.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to guide safe crossing timing at this signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to reduce exposure and allow two-stage crossing on the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers at all legs of the intersection to improve predictability.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a car-oriented bridge overpass with narrow sidewalks and no visible marked crossings at the immediate junction. The proximity to highway ramps and wide travel lanes suggests a high-speed traffic environment that is hostile to pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross unmarked lanes of traffic.

hazards.name: Narrow sidewalk on bridge
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the bridge is narrow and lacks physical protection from adjacent high-speed traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the bridge railing

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at all legs of the intersection to improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian refuge island
interventions.description: Install a refuge island to break up the long crossing distance across the wide roadway.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including a sidewalk and a curb ramp with tactile paving, but lacks a marked crosswalk and pedestrian signals. The roadway surface is significantly degraded at the pedestrian transition point, and the wide lane geometry suggests a high-speed environment.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There is no painted crosswalk to designate a safe path for pedestrians or alert drivers to their presence.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway crossing from the curb ramp

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Significant cracking and potholes in the asphalt at the base of the curb ramp create a trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom center of the image in the roadway

hazards.name: High-Speed Environment
hazards.description: Wide lanes and proximity to highway infrastructure encourage higher vehicle speeds near the pedestrian walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway lanes adjacent to the sidewalk

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install high-visibility ladder or zebra-style crosswalk markings to define the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway at the intersection to eliminate trip hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Add pedestrian crossing warning signs to alert motorists of the potential for people crossing.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked continental crosswalk and curb ramps, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals. The environment is dominated by vehicle-centric infrastructure, including overhead traffic lights and wide turning radii that may encourage higher speeds.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection corners where signals would typically be mounted.

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radius
hazards.description: The wide radius for right-turning vehicles from the side road allows for higher speeds through the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: The corner on the right side of the image.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the asphalt within the crosswalk area could present a tripping hazard.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers and accessible push buttons.

interventions.title: Curb Extension / Radius Tightening
interventions.description: Reduce the curb radius to slow turning vehicles and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicle traffic receives a green light.
